title: Sweep stale help text and machine-output parity gaps
description:
The epic fix audit found help and reference text that lags delivered behavior, plus two commands outside the machine-output contract.

## Background

Issue claim help still reads "Claim an unassigned issue (atomic)" although same-assignee re-claim now succeeds and promotes to in_progress; the CLI reference exit-code section lists only 0/1/2 although the binary uses 0 through 6 and 10; init and graph export reject the machine-output flag entirely.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Issue claim help documents idempotent same-assignee re-claim and the in_progress promotion.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: The CLI reference documents the full exit-code taxonomy matching the implemented set.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Init supports machine output (reporting created paths and repository id); graph export accepts the machine-output flag as equivalent to JSON format on stdout.
